**Position:** Lecturer, Policy Analysis and Research Fellow (LUISS Guido Carli-ULB-Bocconi)

I am a Lecturer and Policy Analyst at LUISS Guido Carli University. I am also an Associate Researcher at the Free University of Brussels, a Fellow Economist at DG GROW (European Commission), and a Research Fellow at Bocconi University. My work focuses on EU competition, industrial, and trade policies in a comparative perspective with those of other major world powers. I am the co-editor of the book EU Industrial Policy in a Multipolar Economy (Edward Elgar Publishing, 2022).
